feature_normalization: brightness / 255; fractions 0..1; contrast -1..1; rates in normalized brightness/second
smoothing_frames: round(0.5 * native fps), including current; available frames at startup
rate_definition: native successive-frame difference * fps; first frame zero
effective_history_note: 2 second TCN context plus up to 0.5 seconds preceding temporal-feature history; causal
reset_policy: Explicit reset on a new independent stream or confirmed cut; no timeout reset.
event_rule: entry -> wait for exit; exit -> wait for entry; none/low confidence preserves state
